title: A Covenant of Friends
text: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

title: Tens of Thousands
text: Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.

title: Beyond You
text: Isn’t the arrow beyond you? | Hurry! Make haste! Do not delay!

title: Go in Peace
text: Go in peace, for the two of us have sworn in the name of the LORD …

title: A Jealous Eye
text: And from that day forward Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

title: The LORD Was with Him
text: … he continued to prosper in all his ways, because the LORD was with him.

title: All Israel Loved David
text: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he was leading them out to battle and back.

title: A Friend Loves at All Times
text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

title: Songs and Tambourines
text: … with joyful songs, and with tambourines and other instruments.
